name: BCC Grid Sampling
definition: Using a Body Centered Cartesian (BCC) lattice, the dual of the Face-Centered Cartesian (FCC) lattice, to store volume data with fewer samples than a Cubic Cartesian (CC) grid.
summary: BCC Grid Sampling is a 3D method using a Body-Centered Cartesian lattice that requires 71% fewer samples than standard cubic grids while maintaining lossless compression for bandlimited signals.
